name: Zombie
languages: one other language (understands but can't speak)

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.summary: At 0 HP it makes a Con save (DC 5 + damage) to stay at 1 HP, unless hit by Radiant or a Critical Hit.
traits.text: When damage drops the zombie to 0 Hit Points, it makes a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 plus the damage taken. On a success it drops to 1 Hit Point instead. It can't make this save if the damage was Radiant or came from a Critical Hit.

actions.name: Slam
actions.summary: Clubs a target with a rotting fist.

summary: Shambles toward the closest living thing and slams it; hard to put down without radiant or crits.
